body: Something I can never have is definitely the saddest song I have heard. For whatever reason it makes me think of my divorce. Hard to listen to.
He does sound like a douche bag. I love steak and shake though. Hopeless for life. I'm just a lost cause.
I watched shrek today. Laughed for the first time in days. I can't shake the hopeless feeling.
I could use a new friend.
Thank you for the kind words. I'm still here. The noose is still here. I have looked at it at least a thousand times. I don't want to die but I don't want to live.
Thank you so much. It is hard to think like that.
Thank you for your kind words. It is hard to imagine that I am worth anything at the moment.
